description: This file defines the Layout class within the Opencart catalog module, providing methods to retrieve layout and module information from the database based on route, layout ID, and position.

classes.name: Layout
classes.description: A class representing layout-related data operations in the Opencart catalog, including retrieving layout IDs and associated modules.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.description: Retrieves the layout ID associated with a specific route from the database, based on the store configuration.

methods.name: getModules
methods.description: Retrieves all module records associated with a layout ID and position from the database.
